ns2:section.sectionText: Due to conflicts with other statistics courses, a change of the meeting times and/or days of this course is expected. To prevent further registration while this is resolved, the course has been set to department approval only. During this time, approval will not be granted. Once the meeting times and days are finalized, registration will be re-opened, with no approval required. Please check back later to see if registration has resumed. Thank you for your patience. Priority registration is restricted to students majoring in Statistics or Statistics & Computer Science. This restriction is expected to be removed sometime during the business day May 3rd, 2016.
